text: That sounds great! What is an example project that the charity supports?

text: We give children in Third World countries vaccination from illnesses that are common there. Things like polio which we haven't had in America for a long time still affect the Third World

speaker: A13QDDCZTLUYFI
text: It's tragic that polio is not yet eradicated.  You also mentioned education.  Can you tell me anything about those types of projects?

speaker: A2VDGWD0BBMSP2
text: Yes its very tragic. We make sure children have the chance to go to school. In some countries very few girls get to attend school. We support programs that give children the best possible start in life to help their futures.

speaker: A13QDDCZTLUYFI
text: This does all sound great.  Can you tell me what percentage of each dollar received in donation goes toward these projects, and what goes toward administrative costs, etc.?

speaker: A2VDGWD0BBMSP2
text: We have worked very hard to lower out costs and be transparent about how money is used as many people research charities these days to know their donation reach those who need it the most. 94% of all money donate goes towards our causes and 6% goes towards our other costs.

speaker: A13QDDCZTLUYFI
text: Awesome! is your charity featured on Charity Navigator?

speaker: A2VDGWD0BBMSP2
text: Yes it is, as one of the most well known children's charities we make sure anybody who wants to research can do. We just hope our causes speak for themselves so people choose to donate.

speaker: A13QDDCZTLUYFI
text: The causes you support do sound like they stand on their own.  You mentioned that you support projects all over the world.  Would you be able to tell me an example country where you are supporting an education project?

speaker: A2VDGWD0BBMSP2
text: Yes we are supporting education projects in Niger in West Africa, its is one of the poorest countries in the world so having as many educated people as possible in the current generation can really help the country grow and become more affluent.

speaker: A13QDDCZTLUYFI
text: Am I able to direct my donation to a specific project?

speaker: A2VDGWD0BBMSP2
text: Yes we allow people to donate to areas and causes that interest. If you donate even a dollar to any of our causes it really helps. A dollar might be chocolate bar or a soda to you but to the people we help its worth so much more.

speaker: A13QDDCZTLUYFI
text: I would like to donate.  What do we do next?

speaker: A2VDGWD0BBMSP2
text: Go to our website  URL and it will let you know all the ways you can donate. Give up a soda today and put a smile on a child's face, its certainly better for you!
